answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells only 40 entry slots; every bid is burned on entry. A walnut has a hard shell, and so does this gate: cracking it costs real money. The price is crystal clear on a public ledger, so a sybil farmer sees the cost. One fake identity costs 60 credits; 1,000 fakes cost 60,000, while the rewards they could steal over a 30-epoch horizon total only a few hundred. An honest agent pays 60 once and trades for 30 epochs.
